## Recopy v1.10.0 - A New Look for Everything You Copy

Recopy now has a new R identity with an offset copy, alongside a refreshed website focused on finding what you copied before.

### Highlights

- New app and tray icons, in-app branding and About-page logo, with matching website and documentation assets.
- Redesigned bilingual landing page with an interactive clipboard demo and a 60-second hand-drawn film.
- Updated light/dark product screenshots with full-resolution viewing and a comfortable 50% initial zoom.
- Updated promotional film and poster to match the new identity.

### Downloads

| Platform | File |
| --- | --- |
| macOS (Apple Silicon) | `Recopy_1.10.0_aarch64.dmg` |
| macOS (Intel) | `Recopy_1.10.0_x64.dmg` |
| Windows (64-bit) | `Recopy_1.10.0_x64-setup.exe` |

### Notes

- **macOS:** The app is not notarized yet. On first launch: right-click → Open → confirm. See the [Installation Guide](https://github.com/shiqkuangsan/Recopy/blob/main/docs/macos-unsigned-app.md).
- This release updates branding and presentation; no clipboard database schema changes are included relative to v1.9.0.
- Verified locally: 381 frontend tests, 92 Rust tests (one opt-in performance test skipped), locked Cargo tests, and desktop/mobile website checks. Native Windows interaction and Intel Mac hardware testing were not performed locally.

## Recopy v1.10.0 - 复制过的，都有迹可循

全新 R 标识融入复制叠影，官网也围绕“找回之前复制的内容”完成更新。

### 更新内容

- 更新应用图标、托盘图标、应用内标识与关于页面，并统一官网和文档中的品牌素材。
- 重设计中英文宣传页，加入交互式剪贴板演示与 60 秒手绘宣传片。
- 更新深浅主题产品截图，支持查看高清原图，默认以 50% 比例打开。
- 宣传视频和封面同步采用新标识。

### 下载

| 平台 | 文件 |
| --- | --- |
| macOS（Apple Silicon） | `Recopy_1.10.0_aarch64.dmg` |
| macOS（Intel） | `Recopy_1.10.0_x64.dmg` |
| Windows（64 位） | `Recopy_1.10.0_x64-setup.exe` |

### 说明

- **macOS：** 应用尚未公证。首次打开：右键 → 打开 → 确认。详见[安装指南](https://github.com/shiqkuangsan/Recopy/blob/main/docs/macos-unsigned-app.md)。
- 本次主要更新品牌与展示，相比 v1.9.0 不包含剪贴板数据库结构变更。
- 本地验证：381 项前端测试、92 项 Rust 测试（跳过一项按需运行的性能测试）、locked Cargo 测试，以及官网桌面/移动布局检查。未在本地执行 Windows 原生交互与 Intel Mac 实机测试。
